name: Time Beetle
oracle_text:
Skulk (This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.)
Parallel Universe — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)
blocked_sentences: Parallel Universe — Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, time travel. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)

needs.what: an op that, for each suspended card the controller owns (in exile, suspended, with time counters) and each permanent they control with a time counter on it, lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it without paying its mana cost as suspend does (702.62), through the same counter-removed funnel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No time_travel op exists. for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters in exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards with time counters), and the free cast on removing the last counter lives only in suspend's upkeep tick, so an effect removing it would strand the card in exile. The rest is expressible: skulk is a keyword (in starting_point) and the trigger is deals_combat_damage_to_player with source self.
